conflicts.detail: Manufacturer list in sentence case, Notino in upper case with trailing period; Notino 'C13-15 ALKANE' = manufacturer 'C13-15 alkane'. Identical items and order (30 items).

'Frei von Sulfaten' vs INCI: no sulfate (Sodium Laureth Sulfate) but Disodium Laureth Sulfosuccinate (a sulfosuccinate) is the lead surfactant. Not a conflict on its face; flag only if the product is ever described as 'free of sulfate-type surfactants'. 'Pro-Vitamin B5' = Panthenol present; Signature Blend (Peptide, Hemisqualan, Gojibeere, Malve, Tahiti-Gardenie) = Avena sativa peptide, C13-15 alkane, Lycium barbarum, Malva sylvestris, Gardenia taitensis all present.

Rossmann.de: PDP for GTIN 4063528078377 redirects to 'Produkt nicht verfügbar'; GTIN search and 'neqi shampoo' search return other Neqi shampoos (Repair Reveal, Diamond Glass, Moisture Mystery, Deep Cleansing) but no Volume Victory. normalization: Canonical list = the ordered INCI items, each lower-cased, trimmed, internal whitespace collapsed; items joined with '|' and sha256 over the UTF-8 string. Split synonym entries (e.g. 'Aqua (Water, Eau)') are merged into one item before hashing; trailing full stops removed.
